decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat to slightly down today (NASDAQ -0.5%, S&P500 -0.4%), a neutral session with no broad risk-on or risk-off signal. Rather than force capital into mediocre names, we used two open slots on BCRX and SNDK, the two top-scored candidates with the cleanest multi-indicator confirmation (RSI in the healthy 55-70 zone, bullish MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20) and the least overbought risk, keeping one slot and cash in reserve.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today in a quiet, directionless session, with NASDAQ down 0.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move, consistent with a market pausing to digest recent gains rather than reacting to new negative news. Individual stocks with strong technical setups, like BCRX and SNDK, continued showing bullish momentum even as the broader indices were flat.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅震盪，納指跌0.5%，標普500指數跌0.4%，走勢欠方向性。市場並無單一主導消息帶動跌勢，較似是消化近期升幅後的整固階段，而非受負面消息衝擊。與此同時，個別股份如BCRX及SNDK仍錄得技術面走強，顯示大市平淡之際仍有資金追逐強勢股。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Technical confirmation means waiting for several independent signals—like RSI, MACD, and price versus moving averages—to all point the same bullish direction before buying, instead of relying on just one. This reduces the chance of chasing a false signal, since multiple agreeing indicators suggest real buying interest rather than random noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 技術確認是指在買入前,同時參考多個獨立指標(例如RSI、MACD及股價與均線的關係),確保它們全部指向同一個看漲方向,而非只憑單一訊號下決定。這樣可以減少誤判假訊號的機會,因為多項指標同時確認,代表真實的買盤力量,而非偶然的市場雜訊。
